page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.24xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The system memory configuration provides 192.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all persistent data must be hosted on external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. The primary hardware tradeoff is the low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU and the complete absence of local NVMe storage, which makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or high-speed local scratch disks.

Given its high core count and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.c9ae.24xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads. Appropriate applications include batch processing, video encoding, scientific modeling, distributed analytics, and high-throughput web serving where raw CPU execution speed is the primary bottleneck.
